 match ethertype ip
 match ip protocol udp
 match destination-port eq 68
!

 match ethertype ip
 match ip protocol udp
 match destination-port eq 67

 match ethertype ip
 match destination-address ip 224.0.0.0/4

 match ethertype 0x86DD
 match destination-address ipv6 ff00::/8
